subject.title: browser tool: include current page URL in before_tool_call params for act/type actions

question: Should browser `before_tool_call` hooks receive a policy-safe current tab URL for `act`/`type`, and should that be exposed by enriching hook params or by adding a scoped browser state query helper?
rationale: This determines a third-party plugin API and security boundary: credential plugins need domain context, but exposing browser URLs must preserve redaction, SSRF, profile privacy, and hook rewrite semantics.

options.title: Expose Policy-Safe Hook URL
options.body: Add an additive documented field to the browser hook event or prepared params that reuses existing safe route URL semantics and fails closed when a safe URL cannot be resolved.

options.title: Add Scoped Query Helper
options.body: Keep params unchanged and provide a hook-context helper that lets trusted plugins ask for the current browser URL under the same browser policy checks.

options.title: Keep Plugin-Local Caching
options.body: Leave core unchanged and require credential plugins to maintain fail-secure URL caches from navigate/open and after-tool-call results.

recommendation.title: Expose Policy-Safe Hook URL
recommendation.body: Add an additive documented field to the browser hook event or prepared params that reuses existing safe route URL semantics and fails closed when a safe URL cannot be resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on safe browser URL responses and route policy decisions needed for the contract shape.
